title: "Multi-omics"

## Module map

The **Multi-omics** menu groups analyses that extend beyond a single DEP table:

| Module | Main question |
|---|---|
| Expression Profile | Which proteins share similar abundance trends? |
| WGCNA | Which co-expression modules and hub proteins relate to traits? |
| Metaproteomics | How do taxonomic and functional compositions change together? |
| Nine Quadrant | How do two quantitative contrasts/datasets agree or disagree? |
| Co-enrichment | Which functional signals are shared or distinct across result sets? |
| Venn | Which identifiers overlap among multiple sets? |

These modules do not all require the same input type. Follow the dedicated page for each analysis rather than assuming the normalized matrix alone is sufficient.

::: {.callout-tip}
For manuscript figures, use an integration module only when the biological question is genuinely cross-layer or network-oriented. A more complex plot is not automatically more informative than a well-supported DEP or enrichment result.
:::
